help.heroTitle: Bengaluru Citizen Civic Redressal Charter & Service Standards
help.heroDesc: UrbanPulse empowers every citizen of Bengaluru to report civic issues directly to municipal squad dispatchers with end-to-end accountability.
help.slaRoadsDesc: Cold-mix patching and asphalt milling by BBMP Road Infrastructure Cell.
help.slaGarbageDesc: Compactor dispatch and sanitation sweep by Solid Waste Management (SWM).
help.slaWaterDesc: Acoustic leak detection and valve replacement by BWSSB Supply Division.
help.slaDrainageDesc: Emergency underpass suction de-watering and primary silt clearance.
help.slaLightingDesc: Hydraulic ladder pole maintenance and underground cable diagnosis by BESCOM.
help.slaTrafficDesc: Immediate traffic obstruction towing and signal restoration by BTP QRT.
help.stepsTitle: How Your Complaint Moves: 4-Step Action Path
help.step1Desc: Citizen pins the exact location and attaches photo evidence via the mobile-ready portal.
help.step2Desc: Automated rule engine classifies the category and assigns the ticket to the designated ward squad.
help.step3Desc: Municipal squads arrive on-site with required machinery to execute the physical repairs.
help.step4Desc: Proof photos uploaded, supervisor inspects completion, and citizen receives status update.
help.do1: Pin the exact location on the Leaflet map for millimeter squad accuracy.
help.do2: Attach daylight photos clearly showing the scale and surrounding landmarks.
help.do3: Keep your ticket ID saved to monitor field movements in real-time.
help.dont1: Do not submit duplicate complaints for an issue that is already marked In Progress.
help.dont2: Do not attempt to touch live fallen electrical wires or enter flooded culverts.
help.dont3: Do not use non-emergency web tickets for active fire or immediate medical crises.
